# sigma_connection (Data Source)

Look up a single connection by `id` (preferred when known) or by `name`. Set exactly one. `name` lookups page through `/v2/connections` client-side and error if the name is not unique (connection names are not guaranteed unique — use `id` to disambiguate).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single connection by name (set exactly one of name / id).
data "sigma_connection" "snowflake" {
  name = "Snowflake"
}

# Use the resolved id, e.g. for a connection grant on an unmanaged connection.
resource "sigma_connection_grant" "analysts" {
  connection_id = data.sigma_connection.snowflake.id
  team_id       = sigma_team.analysts.id
  permission    = "usage"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Connection UUID.
- `name` (String) Connection display name. Matched exactly.

### Read-Only

- `is_audit_log` (Boolean)
- `is_sample` (Boolean)
- `type` (String) Warehouse type, e.g. `snowflake`, `bigquery`, `postgres`.
- `use_oauth` (Boolean)
